verses.ar: طٰسٓࣞ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: These are verses of the Qur'an,-a book that makes (things) clear

verses.ar: هُدًي وَّبُشۡرٰي لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: A guide: and glad tidings for the believers

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُقِيۡمُوۡنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who establish regular prayers and give in regular charity, and also have (full) assurance of the hereafter

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمۡ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: As to those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds pleasing in their eyes; and so they wander about in distraction

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَهُمۡ سُوۡٓءُ الۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Such are they for whom a grievous Penalty is (waiting); and in the Hereafter theirs will be the greatest loss

verses.ar: وَاِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّي الۡقُرۡاٰنَ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
verses.en: As to thee, the Qur'an is bestowed upon thee from the presence of one who is wise and all-knowing

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِاَهۡلِهٖ٘ اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًاؕ سَاٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوۡ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Behold! Moses said to his family: "I perceive a fire; soon will I bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand to light our fuel, that ye may warm yourselves

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُوۡدِيَ اَنۭۡ بُوۡرِكَ مَنۡ فِي النَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَاؕ وَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: But when he came to the (fire), a voice was heard: "Blessed are those in the fire and those around: and glory to Allah, the Lord of the worlds

verses.ar: يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنَّهٗ٘ اَنَا اللّٰهُ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: O Moses! verily, I am Allah, the exalted in might, the wise

verses.ar: وَاَلۡقِ عَصَاكَؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَّلّٰي مُدۡبِرًا وَّلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡؕ يٰمُوۡسٰي لَا تَخَفۡࣞ اِنِّيۡ لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَࣗۖ‏
verses.en: Now do thou throw thy rod!" But when he saw it moving (of its own accord) as if it had been a snake, he turned back in retreat, and retraced not his steps: "O Moses!" (it was said), "Fear not: truly, in My presence, those called as messengers have no fear

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنًاۭ بَعۡدَ سُوۡٓءٍ فَاِنِّيۡ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
verses.en: But if any have done wrong and have thereafter substituted good to take the place of evil, truly, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَاَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِيۡ جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍࣞ فِيۡ تِسۡعِ اٰيٰتٍ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهٖؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Now put thy hand into thy bosom, and it will come forth white without stain (or harm): (these are) among the nine Signs (thou wilt take) to Pharaoh and his people: for they are a people rebellious in transgression

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةً قَالُوۡا هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۚ‏
verses.en: But when Our Signs came to them, that should have opened their eyes, they said: "This is sorcery manifest

verses.ar: وَجَحَدُوۡا بِهَا وَاسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَا٘ اَنۡفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمًا وَّعُلُوًّاؕ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And they rejected those Signs in iniquity and arrogance, though their souls were convinced thereof: so see what was the end of those who acted corruptly

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا دَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيۡمٰنَ عِلۡمًاۚ وَقَالَا الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ فَضَّلَنَا عَلٰي كَثِيۡرٍ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: We gave (in the past) knowledge to David and Solomon: And they both said: "Praise be to Allah, Who has favoured us above many of his servants who believe

verses.ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمٰنُ دَاوٗدَ وَقَالَ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنۡطِقَ الطَّيۡرِ وَاُوۡتِيۡنَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍؕ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الۡفَضۡلُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
verses.en: And Solomon was David's heir. He said: "O ye people! We have been taught the speech of birds, and on us has been bestowed (a little) of all things: this is indeed Grace manifest (from Allah)

verses.ar: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمٰنَ جُنُوۡدُهٗ مِنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ وَالطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوۡزَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: And before Solomon were marshalled his hosts,- of Jinns and men and birds, and they were all kept in order and ranks

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَتَوۡا عَلٰي وَادِ النَّمۡلِۙ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةٌ يّٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّمۡلُ ادۡخُلُوۡا مَسٰكِنَكُمۡۚ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمٰنُ وَجُنُوۡدُهٗۙ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: At length, when they came to a (lowly) valley of ants, one of the ants said: "O ye ants, get into your habitations, lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under foot) without knowing it

verses.ar: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّنۡ قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ اَوۡزِعۡنِيۡ٘ اَنۡ اَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلٰي وَالِدَيَّ وَاَنۡ اَعۡمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرۡضٰىهُ وَاَدۡخِلۡنِيۡ بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِيۡ عِبَادِكَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: So he smiled, amused at her speech; and he said: "O my Lord! so order me that I may be grateful for Thy favours, which thou hast bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may work the righteousness that will please Thee: And admit me, by Thy Grace, to the ranks of Thy righteous Servants

verses.ar: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا٘ اَرَي الۡهُدۡهُدَؗۖ اَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ الۡغَآئِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: And he took a muster of the Birds; and he said: "Why is it I see not the Hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees

verses.ar: لَاُعَذِّبَنَّهٗ عَذَابًا شَدِيۡدًا اَوۡ لَاَاذۡبَحَنَّهٗ٘ اَوۡ لَيَاۡتِيَنِّيۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: I will certainly punish him with a severe penalty, or execute him, unless he bring me a clear reason (for absence)

verses.ar: فَمَكَثَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيۡدٍ فَقَالَ اَحَطۡتُّ بِمَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهٖ وَجِئۡتُكَ مِنۡ سَبَاٍۭ بِنَبَاٍ يَّقِيۡنٍ
verses.en: But the Hoopoe tarried not far: he (came up and) said: "I have compassed (territory) which thou hast not compassed, and I have come to thee from Saba with tidings true

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ وَجَدۡتُّ امۡرَاَةً تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَاُوۡتِيَتۡ مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيۡمٌ
verses.en: I found (there) a woman ruling over them and provided with every requisite; and she has a magnificent throne

verses.ar: وَجَدۡتُّهَا وَقَوۡمَهَا يَسۡجُدُوۡنَ لِلشَّمۡسِ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ فَهُمۡ لَا يَهۡتَدُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: I found her and her people worshipping the sun besides Allah: Satan has made their deeds seem pleasing in their eyes, and has kept them away from the Path,- so they receive no guidance

verses.ar: اَلَّا يَسۡجُدُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ يُخۡرِجُ الۡخَبۡءَ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُخۡفُوۡنَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: (Kept them away from the Path), that they should not worship Allah, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what ye hide and what ye reveal

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيۡمِࣛ‏
verses.en: Allah!- there is no god but He!- Lord of the Throne Supreme

verses.ar: قَالَ سَنَنۡظُرُ اَصَدَقۡتَ اَمۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: (Solomon) said: "Soon shall we see whether thou hast told the truth or lied

verses.ar: اِذۡهَبۡ بِّكِتٰبِيۡ هٰذَا فَاَلۡقِهۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَانۡظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Go thou, with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them: then draw back from them, and (wait to) see what answer they return

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اِنِّيۡ٘ اُلۡقِيَ اِلَيَّ كِتٰبٌ كَرِيۡمٌ
verses.en: (The queen) said: "Ye chiefs! here is delivered to me - a letter worthy of respect

verses.ar: اِنَّهٗ مِنۡ سُلَيۡمٰنَ وَاِنَّهٗ بِسۡمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِيۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: It is from Solomon, and is (as follows): 'In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful

verses.ar: اَلَّا تَعۡلُوۡا عَلَيَّ وَاۡتُوۡنِيۡ مُسۡلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Be ye not arrogant against me, but come to me in submission (to the true Religion)

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اَفۡتُوۡنِيۡ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِيۡۚ مَا كُنۡتُ قَاطِعَةً اَمۡرًا حَتّٰي تَشۡهَدُوۡنِ
verses.en: She said: "Ye chiefs! advise me in (this) my affair: no affair have I decided except in your presence

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا نَحۡنُ اُولُوۡا قُوَّةٍ وَّاُولُوۡا بَاۡسٍ شَدِيۡدٍ ࣢ۙ وَّالۡاَمۡرُ اِلَيۡكِ فَانۡظُرِيۡ مَاذَا تَاۡمُرِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "We are endued with strength, and given to vehement war: but the command is with thee; so consider what thou wilt command

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ اِنَّ الۡمُلُوۡكَ اِذَا دَخَلُوۡا قَرۡيَةً اَفۡسَدُوۡهَا وَجَعَلُوۡ٘ا اَعِزَّةَ اَهۡلِهَا٘ اَذِلَّةًۚ وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: She said: "Kings, when they enter a country, despoil it, and make the noblest of its people its meanest thus do they behave

verses.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ مُرۡسِلَةٌ اِلَيۡهِمۡ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنٰظِرَةٌۭ بِمَ يَرۡجِعُ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: But I am going to send him a present, and (wait) to see with what (answer) return (my) ambassadors

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيۡمٰنَ قَالَ اَتُمِدُّوۡنَنِ بِمَالٍؗ فَمَا٘ اٰتٰىنِۦَ اللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّا٘ اٰتٰىكُمۡۚ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمۡ تَفۡرَحُوۡنَ
verses.en: Now when (the embassy) came to Solomon, he said: "Will ye give me abundance in wealth? But that which Allah has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay it is ye who rejoice in your gift

verses.ar: اِرۡجِعۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فَلَنَاۡتِيَنَّهُمۡ بِجُنُوۡدٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُمۡ بِهَا وَلَنُخۡرِجَنَّهُمۡ مِّنۡهَا٘ اَذِلَّةً وَّهُمۡ صٰغِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Go back to them, and be sure we shall come to them with such hosts as they will never be able to meet: We shall expel them from there in disgrace, and they will feel humbled (indeed)

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اَيُّكُمۡ يَاۡتِيۡنِيۡ بِعَرۡشِهَا قَبۡلَ اَنۡ يَّاۡتُوۡنِيۡ مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said (to his own men): "Ye chiefs! which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission

verses.ar: قَالَ عِفۡرِيۡتٌ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ اَنَا اٰتِيۡكَ بِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ تَقُوۡمَ مِنۡ مَّقَامِكَۚ وَاِنِّيۡ عَلَيۡهِ لَقَوِيٌّ اَمِيۡنٌ
verses.en: Said an 'Ifrit, of the Jinns: "I will bring it to thee before thou rise from thy council: indeed I have full strength for the purpose, and may be trusted

verses.ar: قَالَ الَّذِيۡ عِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمٌ مِّنَ الۡكِتٰبِ اَنَا اٰتِيۡكَ بِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ يَّرۡتَدَّ اِلَيۡكَ طَرۡفُكَؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسۡتَقِرًّا عِنۡدَهٗ قَالَ هٰذَا مِنۡ فَضۡلِ رَبِّيۡࣞ لِيَبۡلُوَنِيۡ٘ ءَاَشۡكُرُ اَمۡ اَكۡفُرُؕ وَمَنۡ شَكَرَ فَاِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ رَبِّيۡ غَنِيٌّ كَرِيۡمٌ
verses.en: Said one who had knowledge of the Book: "I will bring it to thee within the twinkling of an eye!" Then when (Solomon) saw it placed firmly before him, he said: "This is by the Grace of my Lord!- to test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful! and if any is grateful, truly his gratitude is (a gain) for his own soul; but if any is ungrateful, truly my Lord is Free of all Needs, Supreme in Honour

verses.ar: قَالَ نَكِّرُوۡا لَهَا عَرۡشَهَا نَنۡظُرۡ اَتَهۡتَدِيۡ٘ اَمۡ تَكُوۡنُ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "Transform her throne out of all recognition by her: let us see whether she is guided (to the truth) or is one of those who receive no guidance

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ قِيۡلَ اَهٰكَذَا عَرۡشُكِؕ قَالَتۡ كَاَنَّهٗ هُوَۚ وَاُوۡتِيۡنَا الۡعِلۡمَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: So when she arrived, she was asked, "Is this thy throne?" She said, "It was just like this; and knowledge was bestowed on us in advance of this, and we have submitted to Allah (in Islam)

verses.ar: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتۡ تَّعۡبُدُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهَا كَانَتۡ مِنۡ قَوۡمٍ كٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: And he diverted her from the worship of others besides Allah: for she was (sprung) of a people that had no faith

verses.ar: قِيۡلَ لَهَا ادۡخُلِي الصَّرۡحَۚ فَلَمَّا رَاَتۡهُ حَسِبَتۡهُ لُجَّةً وَّكَشَفَتۡ عَنۡ سَاقَيۡهَاؕ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ صَرۡحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّنۡ قَوَارِيۡرَ ࣢ؕ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِيۡ وَاَسۡلَمۡتُ مَعَ سُلَيۡمٰنَ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: She was asked to enter the lofty Palace: but when she saw it, she thought it was a lake of water, and she (tucked up her skirts), uncovering her legs. He said: "This is but a palace paved smooth with slabs of glass." She said: "O my Lord! I have indeed wronged my soul: I do (now) submit (in Islam), with Solomon, to the Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي ثَمُوۡدَ اَخَاهُمۡ صٰلِحًا اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ فَاِذَا هُمۡ فَرِيۡقٰنِ يَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: We sent (aforetime), to the Thamud, their brother Salih, saying, "Serve Allah": But behold, they became two factions quarrelling with each other

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ لِمَ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبۡلَ الۡحَسَنَةِۚ لَوۡلَا تَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "O my people! why ask ye to hasten on the evil in preference to the good? If only ye ask Allah for forgiveness, ye may hope to receive mercy

verses.ar: قَالُوا اطَّيَّرۡنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنۡ مَّعَكَؕ قَالَ طٰٓئِرُكُمۡ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ تُفۡتَنُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Ill omen do we augur from thee and those that are with thee". He said: "Your ill omen is with Allah; yea, ye are a people under trial

verses.ar: وَكَانَ فِي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ تِسۡعَةُ رَهۡطٍ يُّفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: There were in the city nine men of a family, who made mischief in the land, and would not reform

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا تَقَاسَمُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهٗ وَاَهۡلَهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَقُوۡلَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهٖ مَا شَهِدۡنَا مَهۡلِكَ اَهۡلِهٖ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Swear a mutual oath by Allah that we shall make a secret night attack on him and his people, and that we shall then say to his heir (when he seeks vengeance): 'We were not present at the slaughter of his people, and we are positively telling the truth

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرًا وَّمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They plotted and planned, but We too planned, even while they perceived it not

verses.ar: فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكۡرِهِمۡۙ اَنَّا دَمَّرۡنٰهُمۡ وَقَوۡمَهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then see what was the end of their plot!- this, that We destroyed them and their people, all (of them)

verses.ar: فَتِلۡكَ بُيُوۡتُهُمۡ خَاوِيَةًۭ بِمَا ظَلَمُوۡاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Now such were their houses, - in utter ruin, - because they practised wrong-doing. Verily in this is a Sign for people of knowledge

verses.ar: وَاَنۡجَيۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا يَتَّقُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We saved those who believed and practised righteousness

verses.ar: وَلُوۡطًا اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الۡفَاحِشَةَ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: (We also sent) Lut (as a messenger): behold, He said to his people, "Do ye do what is shameful though ye see (its iniquity)

verses.ar: اَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الرِّجَالَ شَهۡوَةً مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ النِّسَآءِؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ تَجۡهَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Would ye really approach men in your lusts rather than women? Nay, ye are a people (grossly) ignorant

verses.ar: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَخۡرِجُوۡ٘ا اٰلَ لُوۡطٍ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَتِكُمۡۚ اِنَّهُمۡ اُنَاسٌ يَّتَطَهَّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: But his people gave no other answer but this: they said, "Drive out the followers of Lut from your city: these are indeed men who want to be clean and pure

verses.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَاَهۡلَهٗ٘ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗؗ قَدَّرۡنٰهَا مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: But We saved him and his family, except his wife; her We destined to be of those who lagged behind

verses.ar: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)

verses.ar: قُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ وَسَلٰمٌ عَلٰي عِبَادِهِ الَّذِيۡنَ اصۡطَفٰيؕ ءٰٓاللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ اَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: Praise be to Allah, and Peace on his servants whom He has chosen (for his Message). (Who) is better?- Allah or the false gods they associate (with Him)

verses.ar: اَمَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَاَنۡزَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۚ فَاَنۭۡ بَتۡنَا بِهٖ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهۡجَةٍۚ مَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ اَنۡ تُنۭۡ بِتُوۡا شَجَرَهَاؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ يَّعۡدِلُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or, Who has created the heavens and the earth, and Who sends you down rain from the sky? Yea, with it We cause to grow well-planted orchards full of beauty of delight: it is not in your power to cause the growth of the trees in them. (Can there be another) god besides Allah? Nay, they are a people who swerve from justice

verses.ar: اَمَّنۡ جَعَلَ الۡاَرۡضَ قَرَارًا وَّجَعَلَ خِلٰلَهَا٘ اَنۡهٰرًا وَّجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ حَاجِزًاؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or, Who has made the earth firm to live in; made rivers in its midst; set thereon mountains immovable; and made a separating bar between the two bodies of flowing water? (can there be another) god besides Allah? Nay, most of them know not

verses.ar: اَمَّنۡ يُّجِيۡبُ الۡمُضۡطَرَّ اِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكۡشِفُ السُّوۡٓءَ وَيَجۡعَلُكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ الۡاَرۡضِؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or, Who listens to the (soul) distressed when it calls on Him, and Who relieves its suffering, and makes you (mankind) inheritors of the earth? (Can there be another) god besides Allah? Little it is that ye heed

verses.ar: اَمَّنۡ يَّهۡدِيۡكُمۡ فِيۡ ظُلُمٰتِ الۡبَرِّ وَالۡبَحۡرِ وَمَنۡ يُّرۡسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشۡرًاۭ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ تَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or, Who guides you through the depths of darkness on land and sea, and Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy? (Can there be another) god besides Allah?- High is Allah above what they associate with Him

verses.ar: اَمَّنۡ يَّبۡدَؤُا الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ وَمَنۡ يَّرۡزُقُكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ قُلۡ هَاتُوۡا بُرهَانَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Or, Who originates creation, then repeats it, and who gives you sustenance from heaven and earth? (Can there be another) god besides Allah? Say, "Bring forth your argument, if ye are telling the truth

verses.ar: قُلۡ لَّا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ الۡغَيۡبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُؕ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ اَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: None in the heavens or on earth, except Allah, knows what is hidden: nor can they perceive when they shall be raised up (for Judgment)

verses.ar: بَلِ ادّٰرَكَ عِلۡمُهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِࣞ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهَاࣞ بَلۡ هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا عَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Still less can their knowledge comprehend the Hereafter: Nay, they are in doubt and uncertainty thereanent; nay, they are blind thereunto

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا تُرٰبًا وَّاٰبَآؤُنَا٘ اَئِنَّا لَمُخۡرَجُوۡنَ
verses.en: The Unbelievers say: "What! when we become dust,- we and our fathers,- shall we really be raised (from the dead)

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا هٰذَا نَحۡنُ وَاٰبَآؤُنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُۙ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: It is true we were promised this,- we and our fathers before (us): these are nothing but tales of the ancients

verses.ar: قُلۡ سِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَانۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "Go ye through the earth and see what has been the end of those guilty (of sin)

verses.ar: وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُنۡ فِيۡ ضَيۡقٍ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: But grieve not over them, nor distress thyself because of their plots

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They also say: "When will this promise (come to pass)? (Say) if ye are truthful

verses.ar: قُلۡ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ رَدِفَ لَكُمۡ بَعۡضُ الَّذِيۡ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "It may be that some of the events which ye wish to hasten on may be (close) in your pursuit

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوۡ فَضۡلٍ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: But verily thy Lord is full of grace to mankind: Yet most of them are ungrateful

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُوۡرُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: And verily thy Lord knoweth all that their hearts do hide. As well as all that they reveal

verses.ar: وَمَا مِنۡ غَآئِبَةٍ فِي السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا فِيۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: Nor is there aught of the unseen, in heaven or earth, but is (recorded) in a clear record

verses.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ يَقُصُّ عَلٰي بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اَكۡثَرَ الَّذِيۡ هُمۡ فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: Verily this Qur'an doth explain to the Children of Israel most of the matters in which they disagree

verses.ar: وَاِنَّهٗ لَهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And it certainly is a Guide and a Mercy to those who believe

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِيۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِحُكۡمِهٖۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۚ‏
verses.en: Verily thy Lord will decide between them by His Decree: and He is Exalted in Might, All-Knowing

verses.ar: فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّكَ عَلَي الۡحَقِّ الۡمُبِيۡنِ
verses.en: So put thy trust in Allah: for thou art on (the path of) manifest Truth

verses.ar: اِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ الۡمَوۡتٰي وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوۡا مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: Truly thou canst not cause the dead to listen, nor canst thou cause the deaf to hear the call, (especially) when they turn back in retreat

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِهٰدِي الۡعُمۡيِ عَنۡ ضَلٰلَتِهِمۡؕ اِنۡ تُسۡمِعُ اِلَّا مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Nor canst thou be a guide to the blind, (to prevent them) from straying: only those wilt thou get to listen who believe in Our Signs, and they will bow in Islam

verses.ar: وَاِذَا وَقَعَ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ اَخۡرَجۡنَا لَهُمۡ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمۡۙ اَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا لَا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And when the Word is fulfilled against them (the unjust), we shall produce from the earth a beast to (face) them: He will speak to them, for that mankind did not believe with assurance in Our Signs

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ مِنۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ فَوۡجًا مِّمَّنۡ يُّكَذِّبُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ يُوۡزَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: One day We shall gather together from every people a troop of those who reject our Signs, and they shall be kept in ranks

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءُوۡ قَالَ اَكَذَّبۡتُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِيۡ وَلَمۡ تُحِيۡطُوۡا بِهَا عِلۡمًا اَمَّاذَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Until, when they come (before the Judgment-seat), (Allah) will say: "Did ye reject My Signs, though ye comprehended them not in knowledge, or what was it ye did

verses.ar: وَوَقَعَ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِمَا ظَلَمُوۡا فَهُمۡ لَا يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: And the Word will be fulfilled against them, because of their wrong-doing, and they will be unable to speak (in plea)

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا الَّيۡلَ لِيَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: See they not that We have made the Night for them to rest in and the Day to give them light? Verily in this are Signs for any people that believe

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يُنۡفَخُ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَفَزِعَ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ وَكُلٌّ اَتَوۡهُ دٰخِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: And the Day that the Trumpet will be sounded - then will be smitten with terror those who are in the heavens, and those who are on earth, except such as Allah will please (to exempt): and all shall come to His (Presence) as beings conscious of their lowliness

verses.ar: وَتَرَي الۡجِبَالَ تَحۡسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَّهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِؕ صُنۡعَ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَتۡقَنَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍؕ اِنَّهٗ خَبِيۡرٌۭ بِمَا تَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Thou seest the mountains and thinkest them firmly fixed: but they shall pass away as the clouds pass away: (such is) the artistry of Allah, who disposes of all things in perfect order: for he is well acquainted with all that ye do

verses.ar: مَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهَاۚ وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَزَعٍ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ اٰمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: If any do good, good will (accrue) to them therefrom; and they will be secure from terror that Day

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ جَآءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتۡ وُجُوۡهُهُمۡ فِي النَّارِؕ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And if any do evil, their faces will be thrown headlong into the Fire: "Do ye receive a reward other than that which ye have earned by your deeds

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا٘ اُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَعۡبُدَ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الۡبَلۡدَةِ الَّذِيۡ حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهٗ كُلُّ شَيۡءٍؗ وَّاُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: For me, I have been commanded to serve the Lord of this city, Him Who has sanctified it and to Whom (belong) all things: and I am commanded to be of those who bow in Islam to Allah's Will

verses.ar: وَاَنۡ اَتۡلُوَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَۚ فَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰي فَاِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِيۡ لِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ ضَلَّ فَقُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُنۡذِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: And to rehearse the Qur'an: and if any accept guidance, they do it for the good of their own souls, and if any stray, say: "I am only a Warner

verses.ar: وَقُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ سَيُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ فَتَعۡرِفُوۡنَهَاؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And say: "Praise be to Allah, Who will soon show you His Signs, so that ye shall know them"; and thy Lord is not unmindful of all that ye do
